limits: Not a complete regional census. Virginia state-only/custom permits not exhaustively retrieved.
Federal bulk active/inactive directory and individual pages could not be independently downloaded in this pass. Federal mirror claims are labelled.
No supplier calls, messages, site visits, rental agreements or pilot collections.
Distances are estimates from Durham City Hall, not an established crew base.
No new lead is verified to satisfy volume, live weight, geography, tissue quality and space/commercial fit together.

fact_review.claude_location: Instructions row 17; Supplier Roster E; Sources rows 9/39/46
fact_review.claude_claim: Initial snapshot used Pikeville; September 28 update changes principal distance fields to Durham.
fact_review.finding: Resolved in current roster: Durham City Hall is now the origin. Sources rows 9 and 39 still contain old Pikeville language; row 46 carries the new method.
fact_review.implication: Main distance mismatch resolved during this pass. Historical synthesis is expressly superseded by the workbook. Some narrative cells remain stale.
fact_review.status: Resolved in current fields; stale notes remain

fact_review.claude_location: Supplier Roster column E; earlier Beebop screen
fact_review.claude_claim: 120 miles used as a road-distance gate.
fact_review.finding: Literal 120-mile radius and a 120-mile drive are different. Both are now shown.
fact_review.implication: EcoFriendly: 92.6 radial / 120.4 road. Acre: 119.7 / 141.1; boundary depends on actual base.

fact_review.claude_location: Instructions row 17; Rated Candidates anatomy scores
fact_review.claude_claim: Initial snapshot emphasized larger market animals and mature sows.
fact_review.finding: September 28 update explicitly adopts 140–220 lb live weight and lowers sow-only anatomy scores.
fact_review.implication: Scope mismatch resolved. Individual animal availability and target-weight weekly counts remain unconfirmed.

fact_review.claude_claim: Updated workbook adopts 2,000–5,000 pigs/week but says no new in-radius plant meets it.
fact_review.finding: Preferred scale is now aligned. No new fully qualified in-band plant was established by either review. That is weaker than proof that no qualifying plant can exist.
fact_review.implication: Small hosts can supplement supply; the research does not establish a Martin’s-scale replacement or a definitive regional absence.

fact_review.claude_location: Sources & Confidence row 7; Supplier Roster D
fact_review.claude_claim: Categories converted into hard weekly ceilings.
fact_review.finding: Federal March 24, 2026 notice confirms categories based on aggregated heads over the prior 360 days. They describe historic slaughter, not rated capacity or each week’s pig count.
fact_review.implication: Keep category separate from actual pigs/week, maximum sustainable pigs/week and suitable-weight pigs/week.

fact_review.claude_claim: Category 3 upper ceiling ~1,917/week.
fact_review.finding: A 360-day interval contains 360/7 weeks. 100,000 * 7/360 = 1,944.4 total heads/week at the exclusive boundary. Category 1 boundary 19.4; category 2 194.4.
fact_review.implication: Even corrected average bounds cannot cap current capacity or quantify pigs at a multi-species plant.

fact_review.claude_claim: Category 4 means all volumes above 100,000 heads.
fact_review.finding: Federal notice lists category 4 as 100,000 to under 10,000,000; category 5 starts at 10,000,000 in 360 days.
fact_review.implication: An annual/category sweep alone cannot identify all current 2,000–5,000 pig/week opportunities.

fact_review.claude_claim: Any implication that numeric category ranges are invalid.
fact_review.finding: The category ranges are real and officially documented. The invalid step is calling historical aggregate averages hard weekly pig/capacity ceilings.
fact_review.implication: This pass narrows our earlier criticism and preserves useful category evidence.

fact_review.claude_claim: 150 lb minimum; disposal charge proves target viscera are discarded.
fact_review.finding: Own terms give a 150 lb hog minimum. A disposal fee does not identify which organs are discarded, who owns them or their opportunity cost.
fact_review.implication: 150–220 lb overlaps user target; 140–149 lb falls below published minimum. Economics remain a hypothesis.

fact_review.claude_claim: Research specimens available; organs without catalogue entries have no competing use.
fact_review.finding: Own specimen-permits page supports a research pathway. Missing retail listings cannot rule out wholesale, rendering, pet-food or private specimen uses.
fact_review.implication: Existing supplier remains valuable benchmark; zero competing value is not established.

fact_review.implication: Elevated to an individually documented qualification prospect. Not a newly discovered company relative to Claude.
